fullPassage: The right to be forgotten is a right distinct from but related to a right to privacy. The right to privacy is, among other things, the right for information traditionally regarded as protected or personal not to be revealed. The right to be forgotten, in contrast, can be applied to information that has been in the public domain. The right to be forgotten broadly includes the right of an individual not to be forever defined by information from a specific point in time. One motivation for such a right is to allow individuals to move on with their lives and not be defined by a specific event or period in their lives. For example, it has long been recognized in some countries, such as the UK and France, that even past criminal convictions should eventually be "spent" and not continue to affect a person's life. Despite the reason for supporting the right to be forgotten, the right to be forgotten can sometimes come into conflict with other rights. For example, formal exceptions are sometimes made for security or public health reasons.

❌ ① recognize: 동사원형 — has been + p.p. 구문에 부적절
✅ ② recognized: 과거분사 — has been recognized ← 정답
❌ ③ recognition: 명사 — has been 뒤에 명사 부적절
❌ ④ recognizing: 현재분사 — has been + V-ing이 아닌 수동태
det.tip: has been recognized = 인정되어 왔다 (현재완료 수동태)

det.korean: ① includes: include의 3인칭 단수형 — 주어 The right(단수)에 맞는 동사
det.analysis:
✅ ① includes: 3인칭 단수 — The right (단수주어) + includes ← 정답
❌ ② include: 원형 — 단수 주어에 부적절
❌ ③ included: 과거분사 — 문맥상 현재 시제
❌ ④ including: 현재분사 — 주동사 자리에 부적절

overlay.excerptSentences: The right to be forgotten broadly __________(include) the right of an individual not to be forever defined by information from a specific point in time. Despite the reason for supporting this right, it can sometimes come into conflict with other rights.

questions.passage: The right to be forgotten is a right distinct from but related to a right to privacy. The right to privacy is, among other things, the right for information traditionally regarded as protected or personal not to be revealed. The right to be forgotten, in contrast, can be applied to information that has been in the public domain. The right to be forgotten broadly includes the right of an individual not to be forever defined by information from a specific point in time. One motivation for such a right is to allow individuals to move on with their lives and not be defined by a specific event or period in their lives. For example, it has long been recognized in some countries, such as the UK and France, that even past criminal convictions should eventually be "spent" and not continue to affect a person's life. Despite the reason for supporting the right to be forgotten, the right to be forgotten can sometimes __________ other rights. For example, formal exceptions are sometimes made for security or public health reasons.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② come into conflict with(~와 충돌하다): 잊힐 권리가 다른 권리와 충돌 가능
det.analysis:
❌ ① be in harmony with: ~와 조화 — 예외 존재하므로 충돌
❌ ② have nothing to do with: ~와 무관 — 관련 있음
❌ ③ take precedence over: ~보다 우선 — 예외 인정하므로 부적절
✅ ④ come into conflict with: ~와 충돌 — 원문 그대로 ← 정답
